description: This file defines the PropertyValue data model, including its validation, search options, and related constants for handling property values in the Mattermost server.

classes.name: PropertyValue
classes.description: Represents a property value with validation and timestamp management.

classes.name: PropertyValueSearchCursor
classes.description: Cursor for paginating through property value search results.

classes.name: PropertyValueSearchOpts
classes.description: Options for searching property values, including filters and pagination.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Prepares the PropertyValue before saving, generating ID and timestamps if necessary.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the PropertyValue fields for correctness.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the search cursor is empty.
